name: Question 20
problem:
$$
B={[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -4\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -7\end{aligned}]},\,[T]_{B|C}=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 6\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 6\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the basis $B$ of ${R}^{2}$ (shown above) and a basis $C$ of ${R}^{3}.$
The matrix $[T]_{B|C}$ of the linear map $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to these bases, and the vector $x\in {R}^{2},$ are also given. Find $[T(x)]_{C}.$
worked_solution:
We can find the coordinates of the image of $x$ under $T$ relative to the basis $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[T(x)]_{C} & =[T]_{B|C}\cdot [x]_{B}\end{aligned}
$$

First, we need to find $[x]_{B},$ the coordinates of $x$ relative to $B.$ So, let

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 6\end{aligned}]={x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$

This gives us the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-1 \\ -4{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2}=6.\end{aligned}
$$

We now row-reduce the corresponding augmented matrix using Gaussian elimination, as follows: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ -4 & -7 & 6\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+4{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+(-2){R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

Finally, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}[T(x)]_{C} & =[T]_{B|C}\cdot [x]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-11 \\ -3 \\ -8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
